concerns.text: The plan reduces each task’s outcome to a binary success/fail label via a majority‑vote over three emulator runs ("Run emulator three times with fixed EMULATOR_SEED=12345. Majority‑vote determines binary Success."). This discards the underlying continuous success probability information (e.g., 0/3, 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 successes) and forces a binary McNemar test, which may reduce statistical power and deviates from the original hypothesis of comparing per‑task success probabilities using a paired t‑test. Consider retaining the continuous success rate per task (or using the full 3‑run counts) and applying the paired t‑test as specified in the specification, or justify why the binary reduction is appropriate.
